lootr.config.client.title: 客户端
lootr.config.particles.description: Configuration options for the display of particles and other effects
lootr.config.particles.title: Particle
lootr.config.particles.unopened_particle: In addition to a visual difference, containers that are not marked as 'opened' by the current player generate particles. [default: true]
lootr.config.textures.description: Configuration options for the textures of containers
lootr.config.textures.title: Texture
lootr.config.textures.vanilla_textures.d: When true, replaces the Lootr-specific textures with Vanilla ones where possible. [default: false]
lootr.configuration.blast_resistance.des: Determines how Lootr containers react to explosions. 'NONE' uses the default blast resistance. 'RESISTANT' makes containers blast resistant, while 'IMMUNE' makes them blast immune. [default: DEFAULT]
lootr.configuration.break_mode.desc: Determines how containers react to being 'broken'. 'DEFAULT' will display the usual message and prevent breaking if the player is not sneaking. 'NEVER' prevents containers from being broken, while 'ALWAYS' allows containers to be broken regardless of sneaking. [default: DEFAULT]
lootr.configuration.breaking.desc: Configuration options relating to the breaking of Lootr containers.
lootr.configuration.brushables_self_supp: If true, Lootr's brushable blocks do not act as 'falling' blocks and instead stay stationary when their supporting block is broken. [default: false]
lootr.configuration.bypass_spawn_protect: If true, Lootr containers that are within the spawn protection area of a world will still be interactable if the player interacting with it does not have permission. [default: true]
lootr.configuration.check_world_border: 禁用世界边界外的转换
lootr.configuration.check_world_border.d: If true, containers that exist outside of the world border will be ignored and not considered for conversion. [default: true]
lootr.configuration.conversion.desc: Configuration options related to the conversion of Vanilla (or modded) containers into Lootr containers.
lootr.configuration.convert_elytras_to_c: 将鞘翅物品展示框转换为箱子
If true, the Elytra item frame found in the End City ship will be converted to a Lootr chest container. [default: false]
lootr.configuration.convert_elytras_to_i: 将鞘翅物品展示框转换为 Lootr 物品展示框
If true, the Eltytra item frame found in the End city ship will be converted to a Lootr item frame. [default: true]
lootr.configuration.convert_structure_it: 转换结构中的物品展示框
If true, item frames found in structures will be converted to Lootr item frames. [default: true]
lootr.configuration.custom_trapped.desc: If true, containers that are 'custom' will emit a redstone signal when opened, as if they were a trapped chest. [default: false]
lootr.configuration.decay.desc: Configuration options related to the decay of containers. [By default, no decay occurs.]
lootr.configuration.decay_all.desc: If true, all containers will decay after being opened. [default: false]
lootr.configuration.decay_dimensions.des: List of dimensions in which containers will decay after being opened.
lootr.configuration.decay_loot_table_mod: List of loot table paths that, if matching that of a container, will cause that container to decay after being opened. [For example, the loot table `minecraft:chests/simple_dungeon` has the 'path' `minecraft`.]
lootr.configuration.decay_loot_tables.de: List of loot tables that, if matching that of a container, will cause that container to decay after being opened.
lootr.configuration.decay_value.desc: The length of time in ticks (20 per second) that it takes for a container marked to decay to actually decay. [default: 5 * 60 * 20 (5 minutes)]
lootr.configuration.desc: Configuration options for server-specific or single-player worlds.
List of dimensions in which Lootr containers will not be converted.
List of dimensions in which Lootr containers will be converted.
lootr.configuration.disable.desc: Prevents any conversion from taking place. [default: false]
lootr.configuration.disable_message_styl: 禁用通知中的样式和格式
If true, the style and formatting of messages related to ticking (such as decay or refresh) will be removed. [default: false]
lootr.configuration.disable_notification: If true, notifications related to ticking (such as decay or refresh) will not be sent to players. [default: false]
lootr.configuration.enable_fake_player_b: Fake players (such as turtles, miners, etc) will be able to break containers if this is true, regardless of the chosen break mode. [default: false]
lootr.configuration.interaction.desc: Configuration options related to interacting with containers.
lootr.configuration.item_frames_self_sup: If true, Lootr's item frames do not break when their supporting blocks are broken. [default: false]
lootr.configuration.loot_table_blacklist: List of loot tables that, if matching that of a container, will prevent that container from being converted into a Lootr container.
lootr.configuration.loot_table_modid_bla: List of loot table paths that, if matching that of a container, will prevent that container from being converted into a Lootr container. [For example, the loot table `minecraft:chests/simple_dungeon` has the 'path' `minecraft`.]
lootr.configuration.maximum_notification: If the remaining duration of a ticking container (such as one refreshing or decaying) in ticks is more than this value, notifications will not be sent to the player. [default: 30 * 20 (30 seconds), -1 disables the limit and will always send notifications.]
lootr.configuration.modid_dimension_blac: List of dimension paths in which Lootr containers will not be converted. [For example, the dimension `twilightforest:twilight_forest` has the 'path' `twilightforest`; the dimension `minecraft:the_nether` has the 'path' `minecraft`.]
lootr.configuration.modid_dimension_whit: List of dimension paths in which Lootr containers will be converted. [For example, the dimension `twilightforest:twilight_forest` has the 'path' `twilightforest`; the dimension `minecraft:the_nether` has the 'path' `minecraft`.]
lootr.configuration.notifications.desc: Configuration options related to notifications that are sent to players.
lootr.configuration.perform_decay_while_: If true, decay occurs during the world tick, meaning that containers will break if they are loaded. If false, containers will only be checked for decay when they are next opened. [default: true]
lootr.configuration.perform_piecewise_ch: If true, features that check structures, such as refresh or decay structure tags, will check each piece of a structure to determine if the container is located in that structure. [default: true]
lootr.configuration.perform_refresh_whil: If true, refreshing occurs during the world tick, meaning that containers will refresh if they are loaded. If false, containers will only be checked for refreshing when they are next opened. [default: true]
lootr.configuration.power_comparators.de: If true, comparators will emit a redstone signal. [default: true]
lootr.configuration.randomise_seed.desc: When true, generates a new seed for each player when generating Loot, instead of using the seed encoded in the container. If a container doesn't provide a seed, a random one will be generated regardless of this setting. [default: true]
lootr.configuration.redstone.desc: Options related to redstone power and comparators.
lootr.configuration.refresh.desc: Configuration options related to the refreshing of containers. [By default, no refreshing occurs.]
lootr.configuration.refresh_all.desc: If true, all containers will refresh after being opened for the first time. [default: false]
lootr.configuration.refresh_dimensions.d: List of dimensions in which containers will refresh after being opened.
lootr.configuration.refresh_loot_table_m: List of loot table paths that, if matching that of a container, will cause that container to refresh after being opened. [For example, the loot table `minecraft:chests/simple_dungeon` has the 'path' `minecraft`.]
List of loot tables that, if matching that of a container, will cause that container to refresh after being opened.
lootr.configuration.refresh_value.desc: The length of time in ticks (20 per second) that it takes for a container marked to refresh to actually refresh. [default: 5 * 60 * 20 (5 minutes)]
lootr.configuration.replace_when_decayed: If true, when a container is fully decayed, it will be replaced with the equivalent Vanilla container. [default: false]
lootr.configuration.report_unresolved_ta: 向玩家报告无法解析的战利品表
If true, when opening a container with an unresolved loot tables (loot tables that resolve to empty), a message will be sent to the player opening to indicate the issue. [default: true]
lootr.configuration.restrictions.desc: Configuration options relating to the restriction of conversion of containers into Lootr containers.
lootr.configuration.save_mode.desc: Determines how aggressively Lootr generates data files. When specified to 'SMART', Lootr will check for Exaroton and other hosts and, if detected, use 'WHEN_OPENED', otherwise 'ALWAYS'. [default: SMART]
lootr.configuration.should_drop_player_l: 破坏的容器掉落玩家战利品

If true, when a container is broken by a player, the contents of that player's inventory (if not generated, it will be generated) for the container will also be dropped on the ground. [default: false]
lootr.configuration.start_decay_while_ti: If true, containers that are eligible to decay and have previously been opened by another player, will start decaying during the world tick. [default: false]
lootr.configuration.start_refresh_while_: If true, containers that are eligible to refresh and have previously been opened by another player, will start refreshing during the world tick. [default: true]
lootr.configuration.title: Server
lootr.configuration.use_problematic_loot: Use the default list of 'problematic' loot tables when constructing the Loot Table Blacklist. [default: true]
